keyEvents.text: Goal! Queens Park Rangers 1, Cardiff City 0. Rumarn Burrell (Queens Park Rangers) right footed shot from very close range to the top right corner following a corner.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Chris Willock replaces Cian Ashford.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Krystian Bielik replaces Calum Scanlon.
